Moerwijk — The Hague, Netherlands

Relatively safer day Average night

In detail

Part of Den Haag Zuidwest, and one of the three wijken CBS names together — with Morgenstond and Bouwlust en Vrederust — as scoring unfavourably against the rest of The Hague on welfare dependency, poverty and crime. The Hague's own figures are published per wijk through Den Haag in Cijfers and the national Veiligheidsmonitor, a population survey run for CBS and the Ministry of Justice and Security. CBS has published separate research on youth criminal networks in Zuidwest specifically. Residential; no visitor traffic.

This rating comes from a structured local-source assessment. This specific area was reviewed against credible local sources — local and national news, municipal and police-published material, and official surveys where they exist — and the signals were consolidated across sources rather than taken from any single report, with the reasoning and the sources shown above. The Hague publishes no comparable neighbourhood-level crime dataset; where a city does publish one, Wandroz uses it instead of an assessment. Where a review finds nothing documented, that is recorded as no findings rather than as a safety rating.

Frequently asked questions

Is Moerwijk safe?

Wandroz currently rates Moerwijk in The Hague as relatively safer than most other neighbourhoods in The Hague during the day and roughly average compared to other neighbourhoods in The Hague at night. This comes from a structured local-source assessment: an area-level review of credible local sources — local and national news, municipal and police-published material, and official surveys where they exist — consolidated across sources rather than taken from a single report. The Hague publishes no comparable neighbourhood-level crime dataset; where a city does, Wandroz uses it instead.

Is Moerwijk safe at night?

At night, Moerwijk is rated as roughly average compared to other neighbourhoods in The Hague. If you're unsure, it's worth checking recent local reviews for your specific street or block, since a neighbourhood-wide rating can't capture block-by-block variation.

Is Moerwijk a good area to stay in as a tourist?

Moerwijk's day rating (relatively safer than most other neighbourhoods in The Hague) is the more relevant one for typical daytime tourist activity; check the night rating too if you'll be out late. You can search accommodation already filtered to this specific area using the Booking.com link on this page.

Is there official crime data for Moerwijk?

Not an official government crime feed — Moerwijk's rating comes from Wandroz's own current local/national press and survey research for this specific area instead (see the note on this page for what was checked and the sources used). An absence of recent negative coverage is treated as inconclusive, not as proof the area is safe. If you live in or know Moerwijk well, you can suggest a correction using the link below.
